newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BACHER PUTS TVL IN STRONG SPOT AGAINST GW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BACHER PUTS TVL IN STRONG SPOT AGAINST GW.

text.p: A flawless unbeaten century from Adam Bacher put Transvaal in a commanding position on a rain-shortened first day of their Supersport Series match against Griqualand West in Kimberley on Friday.
Bacher scored his maiden century in the domestic first-class championship as Transvaal piled up 260 for three on a day in which 34.2 overs were lost to rain.

Bacher made hay on a perfect batting track, easing to his half-century in 128 balls. Once there he unleashed his attack, particularly on spinner Martyn Gidley, racing to his second-half century in only 65 balls.
He hit Gidley for two sixes and added 11 other boundaries to reach 121 not out at the close.
With Neil McKenzie (84) he put on 160 for the second wicket after Mark Benfield had gone for eight on his 'A' section debut.
Skipper Ken Rutherford lasted only four balls but Bacher put on a further 84 with Dean Laing (38) before the third stoppage for rain ultimately forced an early close.
Bowling: Walsh 12.4-2-52-0, Roe 15-0-37-1, English 12-2-58-0, Benkenstein 14-3-47-1, Gidley 15-2-57-1, Light 1-0-7-0.
